answer_html_vi:
signal giữ state có thể ghi; computed derive giá trị read-only; effect chạy side effect khi dependency signal đổi.

Ví dụ:

typescript
const count = signal(0)
const doubled = computed(() => count() * 2)

effect(() => {
  localStorage.setItem("count", String(count()))
})

count.update(v => v + 1)

Không nên dùng effect để propagate state giữa signals nếu computed hoặc linkedSignal biểu đạt được quan hệ đó rõ hơn.
answer_html_en:
signal stores writable state; computed derives read-only state; effect runs side effects when signal dependencies change.

Example:

typescript
const count = signal(0)
const doubled = computed(() => count() * 2)

effect(() => {
  localStorage.setItem("count", String(count()))
})

count.update(v => v + 1)

Avoid using effect to propagate state between signals when computed or linkedSignal expresses the relationship more clearly.
